name: Evil Angel
summary: The iconic director-led gonzo powerhouse founded by John Stagliano in 1989, uniting legends like Rocco Siffredi, Manuel Ferrara, and Jonni Darkko in one huge archive.
ranking_rationale: Unmatched three-decade gonzo vault with genuine director autonomy and raw intensity; skips glossy scripts in favor of high-energy performance.

pricing.notes: Varies by plan and promo; check official checkout.

pros: Enormous 35+ year archive of classic and modern gonzo scenes
Distinctive roster of auteur directors with signature styles
High-intensity performances without bloated scripted filler
Clean Gamma-powered streaming and download platform
cons: Raw, intense style is not aimed at softcore or romantic viewers
Classic vault titles reflect older standard-definition eras

image.alt: Evil Angel logo and brand card

facts.value: Founded 1989 by John Stagliano; online platform via Gamma Entertainment
Paid membership subscription with streaming and downloads
Roster of famous independent directors controlling their own lines
